text: The radar list has overflow-y: visible, which is likely one half of the bug. The arrivals rules in radar.css have no overflow rule, so I will look for the landing band elsewhere, starting with its class names and overflow rules in the ops and desk CSS.
command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src && grep -rniE 'landing' --include=*.css --include=*.tsx ops desk insights 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-250 | head -20; grep -nE 'overflow' insights/desk/desk.css | cut -c1-250 | head -20
